architecture.mechanism: Deliberate fault injection to isolate and characterize transient actuator performance degradation under varying operational conditions
architecture.intervention: Implement a bounded, closed-loop stiction-compensation torque pulse sequence that is conditionally triggered only when telemetry indicates the reaction wheel is in thermal shadow and wheel velocity is below the stall threshold
architecture.expected_effect: The stiction is mechanically overcome by the transient torque pulse, restoring continuous wheel rotation and preventing attitude drift until thermal conditions change
architecture.falsification_test: Execute the torque pulse command specifically during a shadow-phase transient stall event; if the reaction wheel resumes nominal velocity and attitude drift is arrested for the duration of the thermal event, the grease solidification hypothesis is confirmed
